# Keerthi Mohan - Portfolio
> Senior Frontend Engineer building fast Next.js platforms that rank in search and are easy for AI systems to understand.

## About

Keerthi Mohan is a Senior Frontend Engineer based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, with 10 years of experience building React and Next.js platforms. He specializes in frontend architecture, technical SEO, Core Web Vitals, structured data, and AI crawlability.

## Services
- Frontend Web Architecture: React, Next.js, server-side rendering, TypeScript, reusable component systems, and headless CMS integration
- Technical SEO Audits and Core Web Vitals Optimization: metadata, accessibility, rendering, performance budgets, Lighthouse, PageSpeed, Semrush, and analytics
- AI Crawlability and Schema Integration: JSON-LD, Schema.org, robots.txt, llms.txt, server-rendered HTML, and crawler-friendly content

## Results
- Increased Contentstack's Semrush AI Visibility Score from 18 to 38
- Increased Contentstack's AI Search Health score from 42% to 84%
- Maintained Lighthouse performance above 90 across key pages

## Experience
- Senior Software Engineer 2, Contentstack, 2022–Present
- Senior Software Engineer, Y Media Labs, 2018–2022
- Associate Technology, Publicis Sapient, 2016–2018
